build_blip_vqa_model: build a BLIP VQA model with vision backbone, multimodal backbone, and VQA head for visual question answering
extract_visual_features: extract visual features from images or videos using the vision backbone in BlipVQA model
compute_vqa_loss: compute training loss for visual question answering by fusing image and question features through multimodal backbone
predict_vqa_answers: predict answers to visual questions using either rank-based or generate-based inference methods
forward_blip_vqa: run forward pass in loss or predict mode for visual question answering with images and data samples
